items.title: Comparing Reinforcement and Supervised Learning for tuning Large Language-specific Models (2024)
items.description:
Development of an Italian LLM using a multi-stage fine-tuning and reinforcement learning process, including
          Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with the aim of improving language
          proficiency,
          content, and grammar correctness.

items.title: Benchita
items.description:
High-quality few-shot benchmark suite for evaluating Italian Large Language Models,
          supporting the assessment of language understanding, generation capabilities, and task-specific performance.

items.title: Search Engine Implementation
items.description:
Implementation from scratch of a search engine based on an inverted-index architecture. The project includes
          document indexing, query processing, and relevance ranking using BM25 and TF-IDF scoring functions.

items.title: SpeakItalian
items.description:
A computer vision tool for hand gesture recognition, designed to detect and classify gestures
          and enable more natural human-computer interaction.

items.title: Heavy-Tailed Variational Autoencoders
items.description:
Variational Autoencoder architecture based on Normal, Log-Normal, and Inverse
          Gaussian distributions. The project explores heavy-tailed latent-variable modelling for learning robust and
          expressive latent representations.

items.title: Movement formation of a swarm of Robots
items.description:
MATLAB and Simulink implementation of a multi-robot formation-control system. The project simulates a swarm
          of robots coordinating their movement to maintain a predefined formation while navigating towards a target
          position.

items.title: Anomaly Detection on Embedded Devices (2021)
items.description:
Deployment of an anomaly-detection model on NVIDIA Jetson Nano and Raspberry Pi devices for identifying
          anomalous patterns in time-series telemetry data. The project focuses on enabling efficient edge-AI inference
          in resource-constrained embedded environments. Research project part of HORIZON2020, an European program.
